name: FAQ — Bearing
html:
Have questions? Find answers.

Are there fees to buy or sell stocks on Bearing?

Stock and fund trades placed online are commission-free for standard individual cash accounts. Other fees, such as regulatory pass-through fees, wire fees, and paper statement fees, may apply. Review the fee schedule to learn more.

How does an automated investment plan work?

Choose an amount and a cadence, and Bearing places the trade for you on schedule across whatever mix of stocks, funds, or digital assets you have chosen. You can pause or change a plan at any time.

What happens to my portfolio if I upgrade tiers?

Your holdings do not change. Crossing a balance threshold simply unlocks the extra features and pricing tied to that tier on your next statement cycle.

Can I transfer an existing portfolio to Bearing?

Yes. Most transfers complete within one to two weeks, and Bearing may reimburse transfer fees charged by your previous provider up to a set limit.

Have additional questions about investing with Bearing?

Our support team includes licensed specialists who can walk you through an account transfer or a specific order type.

Contact our support team →

name: Mission — Waymark
html:
Trust is one of banking's oldest unsolved problems

In 1994, an early guide to the internet warned that anyone online could claim to be a bank. Three decades later the warning still holds — most business verification still runs on scanned PDFs and someone's best guess.

Our mission is to rebuild trust infrastructure for the global economy. We believe business verification is an engineering problem, not a paperwork problem. Our first product is a platform for compliant onboarding and ongoing lifecycle monitoring. Over time, this becomes a shared trust network — making verification a one-click formality.

Verification infrastructure is mission-critical, but it shouldn't be what your team spends its nights on. That's why it's what we spend ours on.
